item_reviews.comment: Averages match T1 for GKD, KLD and SRKL; the table note supports the four omitted losses.
All 15 loss-by-dataset comparisons improve. GKD's +2.33 is the largest average gain shown.
22.94 vs 23.44 is 0.50 below. It beats the teacher on VicunaEval and S-NI and trails on the other three.
Full Method M is the highest on all five sets in T2, though SelfInst is close (11.56 vs 11.47).
Ordering-only variant is below KLD on four sets and above by 0.09 on SelfInst.
The per-set comparisons hold. Calling temperature the main driver is a reasonable but somewhat interpretive reading of the ablation.
The package states no SDs or tests, an unstated number of training runs, and that the OPT table is excluded.
